title: Murut people - Wikipedia
text: The Murut people or simply the Muruts is the collective name of an Austronesian ethnic group indigenous to Sabah and Sarawak in Malaysia as well as North Kalimantan in Indonesia and Temburong District in Brunei.

title: Murut, Sembakung Language (SBR)... | Ethnologue Free
text: Sembakung Murut is an endangered indigenous language of Indonesia and Malaysia. It belongs to the Austronesian language family. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by a decreasing number of young people.
